children: ENTERS INTO AN AGREEMENT TO ACQUIRE FORMUEPLEJE
ACQUISITION EXPECTED TO GENERATE ANNUAL NET FEE INCOME OF SLIGHTLY ABOVE DKK 0.2 BLN AND WILL BE EPS ACCRETIVE FROM 2028
INTEGRATION COSTS OF ABOUT DKK 0.1 BLN ARE EXPECTED
NET CAPITAL CONSUMPTION IS EXPECTED TO BE CLOSE TO 0.1% OF RISK EXPOSURE AMOUNT OF JYSKE BANK
EXPECTATIONS OF EARNINGS PER SHARE REMAIN UNCHANGED IN RANGE OF DKK 71-85 FOR 2026, CORRESPONDING TO A NET PROFIT OF DKK 4.3-5.1 BLN
COMPLETION EXPECTED IN Q4 2026, SUBJECT TO REGULATORY APPROVALS
